query: New landlord in Pune is asking for 6 months rent in advance as security deposit for a residential apartment. Is that allowed?

model_output.summary: Your new landlord in Pune is asking for 6 months of rent as a security deposit for a residential apartment. According to the law, the security deposit for residential premises should not be more than two months' rent.
facts_extracted: New landlord in Pune is asking for 6 months rent in advance as security deposit
The property is a residential apartment

options.title: Discuss with Landlord
options.description: Show the landlord the rule stating that residential security deposits cannot exceed two months' rent.
pros: May resolve the issue amicably without dispute
cons: Landlord may refuse to follow or insist on their terms

citations.relevance: States that the security deposit for residential premises shall not exceed two months' rent.
